title: goop main screen
brief: Main TUI screen of goop (layout B: chat + offer list). Shows the chat with the Orchestrator, today's offers with score, verdict and NEW badge, the answering model and background search progress. Terminal look, logo palette.

artboards.title: Boxed split
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar bordered boxes, clear focus; borders cost space

artboards.title: Three panes
artboards.tradeoff: Live detail while moving through the list; needs ~160 columns

artboards.title: Borderless cards
artboards.tradeoff: Calm, portfolio-friendly cards; fewer offers fit, needs true color

artboards.title: opencode-style session
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar agent layout: chat + composer, collapsed tool calls, offers sidebar; smaller list, detail opens full view

artboards.title: Home screen
artboards.tradeoff: Logo-centered first screen with prompt and today's numbers; an extra screen, logo hidden under ~30 rows
